label: 1st Edition Normal
provenance: 1st Edition print run — early-era cards carry a '1st Edition' stamp on the artwork.

label: Shadowless Normal
provenance: Shadowless print — a brief 1999 run that lacks both the '1st Edition' stamp and the gray drop-shadow on the art frame. Sits between the 1st Edition and Unlimited print runs.

label: Unlimited Normal
provenance: Unlimited print run — the standard non-holo run sold after the 1st Edition stamp was dropped from the print plate.

label: 1st Edition Holofoil
provenance: 1st Edition print run — early-era cards carry a '1st Edition' stamp on the artwork; replaced by 'Unlimited' in later printings.

label: Shadowless Holofoil
provenance: Shadowless Holofoil — holo cards from the brief 1999 print run lacking both the '1st Edition' stamp and the art-frame drop-shadow.

label: Holofoil
provenance: Pulled from boosters — the holofoil version of the card's base printing.

label: Unlimited Holofoil
provenance: Unlimited print run — the holo version sold after the 1st Edition stamp was dropped from the print plate.

label: Cosmos Holo
provenance: Classic cosmos-pattern holofoil — older era Pokémon TCG products and reprint runs.

label: Cosmos Holo (Trick or Trade)
provenance: Trick or Trade BOOster Bundle 2024 — Cosmos Holo treatment exclusive to this Halloween bundle.

label: Cracked Ice Holo
provenance: Cracked-ice holofoil — themed deck and preconstructed product runs.

label: Cosmos Foil
provenance: Cosmos-foil treatment on retailer/blister promo reprints hosted in TCGplayer's Miscellaneous Cards & Products group.

label: Reverse Cosmos Holo
provenance: Reverse-holo cosmos treatment on promo reprints (e.g. Costco/Best Buy exclusives).

label: Pixel Holo
provenance: Pixelated holo treatment (incl. Pixel Cosmos Holo) on promo reprints.

label: Water Web Holo
provenance: Water-web holofoil treatment on promo reprints.

label: Sheen Holo
provenance: Sheen holofoil treatment on promo reprints.

label: Mirage Holo
provenance: Mirage holofoil treatment on promo reprints.

label: Line Holo
provenance: Line holofoil treatment on promo reprints.

label: Sparkle Holo
provenance: Sparkle holofoil treatment on promo reprints.

label: Energy Holo
provenance: Energy holofoil treatment on promo reprints.

label: Metal Card
provenance: Metal-card collectible reprint (e.g. Celebrations, GameStop metal cards).

label: Promo
provenance: Retailer / event / distribution promo reprint with no special foil treatment (Toys R Us, Best Buy, Build-A-Bear, SDCC, movie promos, etc.) — modelled foil-treatment-only, so the distributor is provenance rather than a separate printing.

label: Reverse Holo
provenance: Pulled from boosters — every booster pack contains one reverse-holo card.

label: Mirror Holo
provenance: The Japanese reverse holo — a mirror-foil parallel printed alongside the regular card. TCGCSV tags it "(Mirror Holofoil)" on a product sharing the base card's collector number.

label: Poké Ball Reverse Holo
provenance: Booster-pack pattern reverse holo — appears on Common/Uncommon/Rare cards in 151, Prismatic Evolutions, and other modern sets that use the ball-pattern gimmick.

label: Master Ball Reverse Holo
provenance: Master Ball pattern reverse holo — rarer booster pull than the Poké Ball pattern in the same sets.

label: Quick Ball Reverse Holo
provenance: Quick Ball pattern reverse holo — booster pull from sets that use the ball-pattern gimmick.

label: Dusk Ball Reverse Holo
provenance: Dusk Ball pattern reverse holo — booster pull from sets that use the ball-pattern gimmick.

label: Love Ball Reverse Holo
provenance: Love Ball pattern reverse holo — booster pull from sets that use the ball-pattern gimmick.

label: Friend Ball Reverse Holo
provenance: Friend Ball pattern reverse holo — booster pull from sets that use the ball-pattern gimmick.

label: Energy Symbol Reverse Holo
provenance: Energy-symbol pattern reverse holo.

label: Team Rocket Reverse Holo
provenance: Team Rocket pattern reverse holo — themed booster pull.

label: Prerelease Stamp
provenance: Prerelease tournament — given out at a set's prerelease events before its retail release.

label: Prerelease Staff Stamp
provenance: Prerelease event staff promo — distributed only to event staff.

label: Build & Battle Stamp
provenance: Build & Battle Box — sealed product that ships with a stamped promo.

label: Pokémon Center Stamp
provenance: Pokémon Center exclusive — bundled with sealed products sold at the official Pokémon Center store.

label: Staff Stamp
provenance: Tournament staff promo — distributed only to event staff at championship events.

label: Winner Stamp
provenance: Tournament winner promo — given to the winning player at championship-level events.

label: Holiday Calendar Stamp
provenance: Holiday Advent Calendar — sealed seasonal product.

label: Trick or Trade Stamp
provenance: Trick or Trade BOOster Bundle — Halloween booster bundle stamped with a jack-o-lantern Pikachu, released annually.

label: Peelable Ditto
provenance: Peelable Ditto — a Ditto-disguised card whose sticker layer peels off to reveal the underlying Pokémon.

label: Black Dot Error
provenance: Black-dot misprint — production error from a specific print run; collectible specifically as an error variant.

label: Missing Variant
provenance: User-curated catch-all for copies whose variant is not yet modelled in the catalog (misprints, undocumented promos, etc.). Each user_printings row carries its own free-text description.
